detail.title: Flora Mandala Digital Personal Weighing Scale
detail.overview: TheAnt Flora Mandala Digital Personal Weighing Scalecombines accurate weight measurement with a stylish decorative design for everyday use. With a high180kg weighing capacityand50g graduation, it is designed to provide precise and consistent body weight readings for daily monitoring, fitness goals and healthy lifestyle tracking.
features: The scale featuresAuto Weight Detection, Auto Zero Reset and Auto Power Offfor convenient everyday operation. Its clearLCD displaymakes readings easy to view, whilelow-battery and overload indicatorshelp keep you informed about the scale's operating status.

Powered by2 AAA batteries, included in the box, the Ant Flora Mandala is ready to use straight out of the box. The package includes the digital weighing scale, batteries and user manual, and the product is backed by a40-month manufacturer warrantyfor added peace of mind.
